title: AI Inside Your Spreadsheet? ONLYOFFICE 10.0 Just Launched! #shorts
description:
ONLYOFFICE 10.0 was announced on October 10, 2026. Context-aware AI tools appear inside office editors including spreadsheets. This is a visual concept reconstruction, NOT a recording of ONLYOFFICE in use or a hands-on review. Confirm which edition, AI setup, and privacy terms apply before enabling AI for sensitive documents.

Official announcement: https://community.onlyoffice.com/t/meet-onlyoffice-docs-10-0-ai-tools-and-modular-apps-50-new-features-1-000-bug-fixes-35-fixed-vulnerabilities-and-more/20986
#ONLYOFFICE #Spreadsheet #AI #Automation #shorts

captions.text: ONLYOFFICE launched version ten with AI tools in the editors.
Imagine working with data in a spreadsheet without changing apps.
AI suggestions must still be reviewed and verified.
Check edition and privacy before trying. Would you use it?

visual_note: Illustrative reconstruction only, not actual ONLYOFFICE interface/recording; no untested workflow claimed.
